title: jPipe justification
description: A justification model as the jPipe compiler emits it (ADR-0001). The runner only runs justifications, not templates. Properties not listed here are allowed and ignored.

implements.description: How the compiler draws the template chain of a justification that implements a template (jPipe 4.0.0 and later). Only the diagram uses it.

elements.description: The ids drawn outside every template, in drawing order.

templates.description: The chain, the template the justification implements first: each is drawn inside the one before it.

aliases.description: The ids of the elements that composition merged into this one.

origins.description: The element in each model it was composed from, nearest first (jPipe 4.0.0 and later). Validation reads it to tell a kind that composition changed from an authoring mistake (ADR-0036).

origin.description: An element as it was in a model that composition built this one from.

id.description: The element's full id in that model.

type.description: The element's kind in that model.

relation.description: From the supporting element to the element it supports.

elements.description: The ids drawn in the template, in drawing order: a placeholder's id stands for the placeholder.

placeholder.description: A template's @support, filled by the element with the same id.

supports.description: The strategies whose support by this id is drawn from the placeholder.
